# AI Hold'em

> AI Hold'em is an open-source browser-based Texas Hold'em game where people play with provider-backed or deterministic AI poker bots under rules enforced by an authoritative poker engine.

The application supports two to six seats, private table links, configurable blinds and stacks, live state refreshes, action and hand history, and privacy-aware public projections. Games use virtual chips, with no real-money betting or cash prizes. The application JSON routes are internal and are not currently a versioned public API.

## Product

- [AI Hold'em](https://www.aiholdem.gg/): Play against AI bots, invite friends to a table, or watch bots play.
- [About AI Hold'em](https://www.aiholdem.gg/about): Learn how the available bots, their settings, the poker engine, and privacy boundaries work.
- [Developer resources](https://www.aiholdem.gg/developers): Architecture, integration status, source documentation, and discovery resources.

## Documentation

- [Source repository](https://github.com/jonime/ai-holdem): TypeScript source, tests, setup instructions, and architecture documentation.
- [Project README](https://github.com/jonime/ai-holdem#readme): Local setup, deployment, security boundaries, and system overview.
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/jonime/ai-holdem/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development workflow and required checks.

- [XML sitemap](https://www.aiholdem.gg/sitemap.xml): Index of localized public pages.
